title: SO-F-09.2 Finding model for organisational intelligence: a finding is a graph claim capped at theory by evidence, promoted to fact only by a person or a verification, with dismissal, correction and adjudication events and no disclosure beyond the reader's permissions
request: Version 2 of this spec, which supersedes SO-F-09 (signed as contract k-so-f-09-finding-model-fo-cbe213, version 2, which superseded the first signed version; the SO-F-09 spec file is unchanged and stays on record, and the manifest and RECONCILIATION mark it superseded by this spec). Reason: owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026: the lead accepted four definitions that the text of SO-F-09 leaves open (a stub session; who may write a verification record; where the 'by' field comes from; how withholding works) and they are written into the contract and pinned with criteria; the scope adds only src/engine/identity.mjs, which definition 3 needs; docs/MODULES.md and changelog.d/SO-F-09.md are already in the signed scope and are not added again. Accepted definitions: (1) A stub session is an agent subject or a raw status op: neither can promote a finding to fact, by a logged status change, an adjudication, a verification or evidence. (2) A verification record may be written by a person, operator or service subject; it takes effect only when its result is a pass, and a record from an agent or with a failed result is kept and changes nothing. (3) The 'by' field of an event is set from the resolved credential (SO-F-01), never from caller input: through the credential-bound entry point a caller-supplied 'by' is ignored, so a forged by of person:x on an adjudication or service:x on a verification makes no finding a fact, and an agent credential in the personal scope resolves to an agent subject, not to person:owner. (4) Withholding is strict: if any source of a finding is withheld from the reader, the whole statement is withheld, with the reasons and corrections in its history and every entity or owner drawn from a withheld source, and an entity or owner with no source (source null) is withheld from every partial view; the reader sees only how many sources are withheld. Provisional: who may adjudicate (a person), who may verify (a person, operator or service), who may dismiss (any subject, as the code does today) and the two adjudication outcomes, confirm and reject, are provisional until the permission matrix (ADR 5, open, in docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md) and the decision and blocker workflow (SO-A-05) are decided; they are kept in one table so that deciding them changes one place. Pull request #362 builds this contract (head fe3d7f3, stacked on #349). Every requirement, criterion and scope entry of SO-F-09 is kept. Build layer of the Scope One programme, adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026 (fold id SO-F-09) and validated against memev main at d1c65ef. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository; they are cited by id only. Implements the design records SO-2.04 (Cross-project intelligence: evidence-backed discovery across otherwise independent work); SO-2.01 (Organisational knowledge model: relationships between people, teams, projects, decisions, artefacts and evidence) (contracts/scope-one/specs). The decision record cites this contract by id and keeps only the gaps this one does not cover. Memev contracts that land first: SO-F-01, SO-F-02. Page: docs/ORGANISATIONAL-INTELLIGENCE.md comes from the federation architecture documentation (PR #223, branch docs/federation-architecture, not on main); until that merges, the first contract to need a page creates it with its Status section, labelled planned or architectural target, and the later ones extend it. Source in the fold: #222 section 13.6 (evidence-led and cautious; dismissal and correction) and #223 ORGANISATIONAL-INTELLIGENCE.md (evidence and authority). Settled decisions this contract follows (owner decision 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md): topology is local-first and the cloud is only a relay and a backup; every supported provider stands on equal footing and no work or tier depends on one; crdt-merge is reached only through the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs (docs/EXTENSION-POINTS.md) and this contract adds no merge engine to the core; tiers follow docs/PRICING.md (Free core, Personal for up to 3 computers with no per-computer add-on, higher tiers by contacting us) with no Personal trial; the git backup keeps running every few minutes (sync.interval_min). Memory authority: ADR 7 (memory and project-state authority) is proposed in PR #325 and is not decided here; this contract cites it and the local-first decision, and keeps one store under the vault with no second database. Provenance: adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026. Changes: (1) converted from the vault task format to the memev spec format (named tests run as red-green checks on the own test file of the contract; inline regular expression flags became the flags key; hygiene and decision verifiers became commands or doc checks). (2) removed fold-only fields and the owner-decision marker field, reworded the stop rule that named a patent, and made the text pass the leak scan. (3) The fold said the graph holds claims with status fact, theory and conjecture; src/engine/graph.mjs has five (fact, theory, conjecture, contested, refuted). The cap applies to promotion to fact; contested and refuted stand as the graph derives them. (4) Boundary with PG-10.1 WP10-01 and WP10-02 (knowledge status lattice and status fields): the lattice of a fact is owned there. This contract defines only what a finding is and its cap, and maps the cap into the lattice (at most corroborated) once it lands.

tasks.description: The intelligence layer should not become an unbounded inference engine. The graph (src/engine/graph.mjs) already holds claims with status (fact, theory, conjecture, contested, refuted) and provenance, promoted and demoted as evidence arrives. A finding is such a claim with source event links, affected entities, scope and time context and confidence, whose evidence-derived status is capped at theory; fact needs a person's event or a verification record; ordinary claims keep today's rule. Conflict detection, precision and recall and decision routing are SO-F-13. (4) Withholding is strict: if any source of a finding is withheld from the reader, the whole statement is withheld, with the reasons and corrections in its history and every entity or owner drawn from a withheld source, and an entity or owner with no source (source null) is withheld from every partial view; the reader sees only how many sources are withheld. stop_rules: Stop and post BLOCKED when a criterion cannot pass without weakening a test, skipping a test or relaxing an assertion.
Stop and ask when the work would name a client product, a person, a server or a seat in repository text; the client names live in docs/CLIENTS.md only.
Stop when the work would add a runtime dependency, a model call, a network call at install or start, a second store for project state, or any reporting that is not opt-in and off by default.
Stop when the work would move convergence logic into the core, vendor the engine, or add a merge engine beside the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs.

Stop when the work would implement a federation, replication, trust, admission or computation feature beyond the specification, schema, validator and conformance test the contract names; the product keeps the planned label on it.
If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.
